headline: Wall Street Ends Mixed as Apple Declines and Midterms Focus Investors
summary: Wall Street indices closed in mixed directions, pressured by a drop in Apple shares as investors focused on the US midterm elections.
why: US equity indices represent the benchmark performance for global financial markets, and large-cap tech stocks like Apple heavily influence index direction.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Apple shares dropped and exerted downward pressure on the broader market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The market moved lower for the Dow as Apple shares declined following an earnings or operational alert, combined with caution surrounding the US midterm elections.
